name: Audiobook generator
description: Convert any library book to a chaptered M4B/MP3 audiobook using PocketTTS, with threaded narration at a half+1 CPU cap and any-format source extraction.
author: GoodBooks

requires.gb_retry: bounded retry for transient TTS failures

notes: Accepts every format gb_extract supports. A DRM-encrypted file is reported as such rather than attempted.
